surface("library-loan-form", sendDataModel=true)
$/loan/patronName = ""
$/loan/bookTitle = ""
$/loan/checkoutDate = ""
$/loan/renewedBefore = false
$/loan/returnStatus = []

patronNameField = TextField("Patron Name", $/loan/patronName, "shortText", null, null, [?required($/loan/patronName, "Patron Name is required")])
